headline: Fed Chair Warsh on why the Fed didn't *raise rates* this week
quote: Quashing inflation is not about some fixed individual date on a calendar
title: Fed Chair Warsh: Why not raise interest rates today?
caption: October 28, 2026: a reporter asks why the Fed held rates steady when many officials seem to favor a hike in December. Chair Kevin Warsh answers.
context: US inflation over the last 12 months: *{yoy:CPIAUCSL}%*. The Fed's goal: *2%*.
comment: Should the Fed raise rates in December? 👇
